g.text: this.wrappedIterator=new PeekingKeyValueIterator<Bytes,LRUCacheEntry>(){@Override public KeyValue<Bytes,LRUCacheEntry>peekNext(){return cachedPair(cacheIterator.peekNext());}@Override public void close(){cacheIterator.close();}@Override public BytespeekNextKey(){return cacheFunction.key(cacheIterator.peekNextKey());}@Override public booleanhasNext(){return cacheIterator.hasNext();}@Override public KeyValue<Bytes,LRUCacheEntry>next(){return cachedPair(cacheIterator.next());}private KeyValue<Bytes,LRUCacheEntry>cachedPair(final KeyValue<Bytes,LRUCacheEntry>next){return KeyValue.pair(cacheFunction.key(next.key),next.value);}}
